comments.name: GlobalCitizen_Leo
comments.content: This 'whistleblower' situation in the US military media is pretty concerning, really makes you question press freedom even in supposedly democratic nations. It's not just about one person; it's about the systemic pressure on truth-tellers when powerful institutions are exposed. Globally, you see similar patterns of information control. It's a stark reminder that transparency and accountability are constant struggles, everywhere. What's freedom of the press if critical voices are silenced?

comments.name: 资本守夜人
comments.content: LV关闭多地门店并不仅仅是渠道收缩，这标志着中国奢侈品消费市场从“狂热扩张期”进入“存量博弈期”。核心逻辑有三点：第一，K型消费分化，中产阶级购买力因地产溢价消失而萎缩；第二，品牌方正将资源集中于一线超头部旗舰店，以维持稀缺性；第三，汇率波动导致价差抹平，海外消费回流动力不足。这对于下半年可选消费板块是一个强烈的预警信号。📉
